name: create-package
title: Create a New Package in a Monorepo
description: Scaffold a new publishable workspace under packages/<name> with sensible defaults — tsup ESM build, @lhx-kit/tsconfig extension, files whitelist, publishConfig.access=public, bilingual README, MIT LICENSE. Prefer the CLI over hand-editing: lhx-cli add package <name> enforces naming rules, scope detection, and monorepo-root validation in one shot.

references.title: Project walkthrough: full setup from scratch
